request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real skin, fur, fabric and landscape texture, natural light and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

Keep the main subject of the photo whole inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps it whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.

A GOOD DAY: one man of about thirty-five walks along a sunny park path on a bright morning, smiling widely and happily, face turned up to the warm sun, arms relaxed and open, holding a takeaway coffee cup in one hand. Blue sky, green trees, golden sunlight on his face. He is clearly having a very good day: relaxed, happy, nothing wrong. Seen from the waist up, sharp. Exactly one person. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere. Every visible hand has five natural fingers.

cost.basis: Reported usage at list prices checked 2026-11-16; before tax, not an invoice.
